data.reasoning: The package is a standard Rust AUR package with pinned git sources and checksums. The build process uses standard cargo commands with locked dependencies. data.disagreement_analysis: The first model (qwen) encountered an HTTP 400 BadRequestError when auditing .nvchecker.toml, resulting in an 'inconclusive' overall verdict. The second model (deepseek) successfully audited the same file and correctly identified it as a standard, safe nvchecker configuration. The disagreement is an artifact of a tool failure, not a genuine security dispute.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .nvchecker.toml due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400)
learnings: Handle transient LLM API errors gracefully; if a low-risk metadata file like .nvchecker.toml fails to audit, the tool should not force an 'inconclusive' package verdict when all executable/packaging files are verified safe.
